dataset.name: FLIP2 Tryptophan Synthase beta-Subunit (TrpB)
dataset.finite_pool_rule: At most 5,000 rows per partition selected by smallest SHA-256 sequence hash

intervention.changed_component: assignment of measured source outcomes to source mutation features
intervention.true_condition: measured source outcomes remain attached to their observed variants
intervention.null_conditions: 99 deterministic permutations of the same source outcomes across the same source variants

protocol.primary_estimand: mean paired best-so-far AUC of the true source-outcome assignment minus the mean over outcome-permuted assignments
protocol.primary_test: one-sided finite randomization test with plus-one correction over 99 null assignments
protocol.claim_boundary: This independently preregistered audit tests whether the LLM-selected additive executor benefits specifically from the correct TrpB source sequence-outcome binding. It is an external finite-pool replay, not a wet-lab discovery or universal cross-domain claim.
